temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened by tasks during the community service project. In dialogue, she initially says she can manage, then accepts Arthur's help organizing medical supplies.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: No specific prior belief about Teresa's workload; he had not yet judged that she needed help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he forms the belief that Teresa is overburdened and needs assistance, and that she may be hesitant but accepts help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is overwhelmed and could use help; she accepted assistance with medical supplies.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer help and assist Teresa with tasks to ease her burden.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa expresses that she wants to prove she can do tasks by herself and appreciates Arthur's point; she accepts that teamwork can help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability; Arthur feels empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his belief is confirmed and refined: Teresa's hesitation comes from self-reliance, and she may become more open after reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa wants to be self-reliant but can understand that accepting help does not undermine her ability.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa that accepting help does not undermine her abilities and encourage teamwork.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa says it has been a busy day and she feels like she is falling behind, despite Arthur's earlier reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After reassuring her, Arthur believes Teresa understands that accepting help doesn't undermine her capability and may be more open to teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he updates to believe Teresa is still struggling and his prior approach is not yet yielding results.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa remains overwhelmed; reassurance alone has not solved the workload, so a different supportive approach is needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa without making her feel inadequate; propose working together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees to the collaborative approach and says it already feels less overwhelming; they plan to divide tasks and check in.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believes Teresa is still struggling and they have agreed to try working together, but he is not yet certain it will work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—the collaborative approach appears effective and Teresa is receptive, strengthening his belief it will ease the burden and improve efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Working together will ease Teresa's burden and improve efficiency; the collaborative plan is promising.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach, handle inventory, and coordinate with Teresa.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees their teamwork paid off, calls it a great experience, and supports continuing collaboration in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believes the collaborative approach is effective and promising for easing Teresa's burden and improving efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—the positive outcome confirms that collaboration strengthened their professional relationship and should be maintained.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their collaboration has been successful, improved their work, and strengthened their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects with Teresa.
